prompt: We already have a volunteer waiver as a Docusign template. Turn it into a web form we can link from our volunteer sign-up page, so volunteers fill it in and sign right on the form. Pass the event code from the link so we know which event they signed up for.

features: created from the eSignature template (Transform a template)
signature page with template and recipient connections
hidden data field event_code prefilled from the URL
text tabs mapped to form fields

acceptance: the form is linked to the eSignature template and every form field maps to a tab
the event code arrives in a hidden data field and prints on the waiver
the volunteer signs on the form; no email round trip
hard_parts: Upload refuses a web form linked to an eSignature template: the bundle must say the form is made in the builder from the template, not uploaded
URL prefill on a live form is not proven (the bot check needs a real browser)
